tools.description: Navigate the active page to a URL
tools.name: navigate
tools.title: Navigate

tools.description: Snapshot: one line per node with a stable ref (@eN, unique per snapshot), role/name/value, plus page text. Default is the real Accessibility tree (shadow + same-process frames; hidden/ignored subtrees excluded). mode:"legacy" keeps the old DOM heuristic (the only path that stamps an attribute into the page); mode:"text" is text-only. frame=<CDP frameId> from targets scopes the snapshot to that iframe (same-process first; OOPIF is a follow-up). AX refs resolve by backend node id, so a shadow ref is actionable exactly like a light-DOM ref. Paging: pass the snapshotId from the offset:0 render with offset>0 (required; paging slices that render and never re-renders).

snapshotId.description: required when offset > 0: the id returned by the offset:0 render

tools.name: snapshot
tools.title: Snapshot

tools.description: PNG screenshot of the active page (unavailable with GLADIUS_BACKEND_CAPS=dom-only: no rendering pipeline). Optional path: an ABSOLUTE filesystem path the decoded PNG is also written to (missing parent directories are created; a failed write is a typed error, never a silent success). There is no allowlisted screenshot root: only absolute paths are accepted, and a relative path is rejected. When path is absent the reply shape is unchanged. deterministic:true pins the capture: device metrics fixed (current viewport, or width/height; deviceScaleFactor 1, mobile false) and restored afterwards, prefers-reduced-motion:reduce while the capture runs, cleared back to the engine/host default afterwards (a host that asks for reduced motion reports reduce again, so the guarantee is unchanged-from-baseline; reducedMotionEmulated reports whether the emulation was applied at all, and the freeze stylesheet is what stops CSS animation), a temporary style element freezing animation/transition/caret-color/scrollbars, applied by a walk that reaches the main document, every same-process descendant frame and every OPEN shadow root, and that pauses WAAPI animations, SVG SMIL timelines and media playback (each pinned to its start, because a pause at a wall-clock position is not reproducible); a realm the walk cannot reach is named in freeze.skipped, then `document.fonts.status === 'loaded'` plus every `FontFace` reaching `loaded` or `error` (a face still loading at the budget is counted in `fontsPending` and named in `settleTimeouts`), every img complete and two animation-frame ticks before Page.captureScreenshot({format:png, fromSurface:true, captureBeyondViewport for full page}). The reply then carries viewport, deviceScaleFactor, url, byte length, a cheap content checksum, reducedMotionEmulated, settled, settleTimeouts, fontsPending, freezeMode and freeze. deterministic pins the capture so two captures of the same page in the same engine produce the same PNG bytes; the scope of the freeze is the main document, same-process frames, open shadow roots, CSS animation, WAAPI, SMIL and media (see freeze). Canvas, WebGL, video frames and cross-process iframes are sampled, not frozen. Everything rides CDP: no OS cursor, no OS keyboard, no window, no foreground tab.
tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot

tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector (first match) or AX ref (@eN from snapshot; exact). The click is exactly two CDP events at the element's exact float box centre: mousePressed then mouseReleased - no mouseMoved, no hover, no movement loop, no interpolation. hoverFirst:true sends ONE mouseMoved at that same point first, for pages whose handlers read hover state; the default is false. frame=<CDP frameId> from targets scopes to that iframe (same-process CSS selectors; refs are main-frame only - with frame= use a CSS selector; OOPIF without a mapped target is a typed error, never a main-frame click)
tools.name: click
tools.title: Click

tools.description: Type text into an element by CSS selector (first match) or AX ref (@eN from snapshot; exact). frame=<CDP frameId> from targets scopes to that iframe (same-process CSS selectors; refs are main-frame only - with frame= use a CSS selector; OOPIF without a mapped target is a typed error, never a main-frame type)
tools.name: type
tools.title: Type

tools.description: Evaluate a JS expression in the page, await promises. Optional realm routing: target=<CDP targetId> evaluates in that target's realm (page, dedicated/shared worker, service worker); frame=<CDP frameId> evaluates in that iframe's realm (isolated world, works cross-origin). Without either, the active page's main frame. target and frame are mutually exclusive.
tools.name: evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate

tools.description: Wait for a selector/text, a JS expression condition, a delay, or network idle (max 15s). networkIdle:true waits for a quiet-network window of idleMs (default 500); a page that never goes idle returns the typed timeout. expression: polls the active page until the JS evaluates truthy (backoff cadence inside ms); expiry is the typed timeout.
tools.name: wait_for
tools.title: Wait For

tools.description: List every CDP target with its stable id (pages, workers of all kinds) plus the active page's frame tree (main frame + nested iframes, each with its frameId), or make a page target current. action list (default)|select; select needs target=<targetId> (page targets only; worker realms are reached via evaluate target=).
tools.name: targets
tools.title: Targets

tools.description: JS-dialog policy and record. The reader auto-handles every alert/confirm/prompt/beforeunload with the policy (default accept) so a session never deadlocks; the dialog's own text is recorded. action get (default: last dialog + current policy)|policy (set default: needs accept bool, optional promptText for prompt dialogs).
tools.name: dialog
tools.title: Dialog

tools.description: Navigation history on the active page: back|forward step one entry, reload replays the current one. Returns the live url+title after the load settle; a step past the boundary is a typed error, never a silent no-op.
tools.name: history
tools.title: History

tools.description: Observable network: captured requests/responses (method, url, status, resource type, timing) since the Network domain was first enabled, cap 500. action get (default)|drain|clear; filter is a plain substring matched against the url; limit caps returned (default 100).
tools.name: network
tools.title: Network

tools.description: Raw CDP escape hatch: send any protocol method with params on the browser-level connection or on one named session. Returns the raw CDP result; a CDP error reply is a tool error (isError), never a protocol error.
tools.name: cdp
tools.title: CDP

tools.description: Console capture: buffered console messages + uncaught exceptions, each {type,text,url,line,ts}. Ring buffer, cap 200. action get (default)|drain|clear; limit caps returned (default 100).
tools.name: console
tools.title: Console

tools.description: Set files on an <input type=file> by CSS selector (first match) or AX ref (@eN from snapshot; exact). paths[] must exist locally. frame=<CDP frameId> from targets scopes to that iframe (same-process CSS selectors; refs are main-frame only - with frame= use a CSS selector; OOPIF without a mapped target is a typed error, never a main-frame upload)
tools.name: upload

tools.name: hover
tools.title: Hover

tools.description: Choose a <select> option by value (preferred) or visible text; element is a CSS selector or AX ref (@eN). frame=<CDP frameId> from targets scopes to that iframe (same-process CSS selectors; refs are main-frame only - with frame= use a CSS selector; OOPIF without a mapped target is a typed error, never a main-frame select)
tools.name: select
tools.title: Select

tools.description: Press a named key (Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, ...) on the focused element. Combos with '+' (Ctrl+A, Shift+Tab, Alt+F4, Meta+C; case-insensitive modifiers, last token is the base key) hold modifiers (Alt=1/Ctrl=2/Meta=4/Shift=8); with Ctrl/Meta/Alt held the base dispatches as rawKeyDown with no text (Ctrl+A never inserts text)
tools.name: key
tools.title: Key

tools.description: Set the page viewport in CSS pixels (Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride) and return the applied metrics plus a live read-back of window.innerWidth/innerHeight/devicePixelRatio, so an override the engine ignored cannot read as success. reset:true clears the override and restores the engine default (width/height are then ignored). The override is replayed on every new tab.
tools.name: viewport
tools.title: Viewport

tools.description: List, open, close, or select browser tabs (pages)
tools.name: tabs
tools.title: Tabs

tools.description: Cookies + Web Storage in one call. action get|set|clear|save|load (default get); scope cookies|localStorage|sessionStorage|all (default all). save/load persist a versioned JSON file (replies carry counts/bytes/origin only, never values); load enforces an origin match unless force:true. allSites:true widens cookie get to every site and cookie clear to the whole profile (clear with allSites on an attached engine needs confirm:true). redact:true masks get values. sessionStorage is tab-scoped (clears with the tab) while localStorage persists.
tools.name: storage
tools.title: Storage

tools.description: Prove geometry without pixels: one call, one or many targets (ref @eN and/or CSS selector, string or array), several checks. Checks: exists (default true; false asserts absence), visible (a real box, not display:none/visibility:hidden/collapse, opacity>0), stableFrames (N animation frames, identical bbox), box {x,y,w,h,tolerance} in VIEWPORT CSS px from DOM.getBoxModel, hitTarget (elementFromPoint at the exact centre is the target or a descendant - the same guard click uses), computed (subset of getComputedStyle, string-exact), noOverflow (scrollWidth/Height <= clientWidth/Height + tolerance), inViewport (whole box inside the visual viewport). Returns per-check {target, check, pass, expected, actual, delta} plus an overall pass. deterministic:true measures under the same freeze a deterministic screenshot uses (animation:none, WAAPI/SMIL/media held, frames and open shadow roots walked) and echoes freezeApplied:true - the ONLY way to compare geometry with a deterministic capture, because that capture measures the animation-off state. screenshotOnFail:true adds one deterministic capture's path/bytes/checksum. Values are engine measurements (DOM.getBoxModel + Runtime.evaluate), never guesses. Headless + CDP only: no OS cursor, no OS keyboard, no window, no foreground tab.
tools.name: assert_layout
tools.title: Assert Layout

tools.description: The where-is-it-actually primitive: every match of a selector or ref list with its viewport rect, page-coordinate box (DOM.getBoxModel), content quad count, scroll size (scrollWidth/Height vs clientWidth/Height), computed display/visibility/opacity, a z-order hint (paint order, z-index, position, stacking-context flag) and every detected overlapping pair with its intersection rect and area (includeOverlaps default true). Main frame; read-only; engine measurements only. Headless + CDP only: no OS input, no window.
tools.name: layout
tools.title: Layout

tools.description: Deterministic visual-regression baselines under GLADIUS_VISUAL_DIR (default %LOCALAPPDATA%/gladius/visual on Windows, never the caller's cwd), names sanitised to [A-Za-z0-9._-]. The store is capped at 500 baselines and 500 .diff.png by-products (GLADIUS_VISUAL_CAP overrides both): a save at the cap is a typed refusal naming `visual delete` and GLADIUS_VISUAL_CAP, never a silent eviction, while overwriting a stored baseline is always allowed; .diff.png files are the only by-products aged out automatically (oldest first) and `list` reports dir, count, cap and diffCount. action save captures a deterministic PNG named <name> plus <name>.meta.json (browser, viewport, deviceScaleFactor, url, checksum, createdAt). compare captures the same deterministic shot and diffs it against the baseline in a scratch headless target created with background:true (the engine decodes both PNGs onto a canvas - no new runtime dependency), returning two separate verdicts plus the numbers: pixelsIdentical (checksum == baselineChecksum, a fact about the bytes, never a judgement) and passWithinTolerance (the whole predicate: no size mismatch, diffPixels/maxDiffPixels, ratio/maxDiffRatio, ignoredPixels when allowIgnoredAA is off, and environment.match when requireEnvironmentMatch is on). pass is an ALIAS of passWithinTolerance, always equal to it, kept for 0.7.x clients; it means 'the diff is within the requested tolerance', never 'the images are the same'. Also returned: diffPixels, totalPixels, ratio, bbox, maxChannelDelta, baselinePath, diffPath and environment {match, known, unknownAxes, baseline, current}; the environment compares browser major AND full version, viewport, deviceScaleFactor, platform, user agent, colour scheme, forced colours, contrast and reduced-motion preferences, the installed-font fingerprint and the scrollbar width - all read live - and any mismatch adds a baseline_environment_mismatch warning (not a failure unless requireEnvironmentMatch:true), while an axis a 0.7.x sidecar does not record is named in unknownAxes and reported as baseline_environment_unknown_axes, never as a silent match. Anti-aliasing is subtracted by a deterministic rule - a candidate whose 3x3 luminance neighbourhood has >=32 levels of contrast in BOTH images is suppressed when its 4-connected component is no larger than minDiffCluster (default 2) - and that subtraction does NOT pass by default: allowIgnoredAA:true is the explicit opt-in that re-admits it, and the warning always names the count and the flag. The threshold is never raised for tolerance. antialias (default true) and includeAA (default false) are inverses. threshold is a per-channel fraction of the 0-255 range (default 0.1), maxDiffPixels/maxDiffRatio set the pass bar (default 0/0), maskRects skip regions and are metered (maskRectsApplied echoes the clipped rects, maskedPixels counts their union, maskCoverageRatio is that over totalPixels, a rect that clips away is named mask_rect_dropped and coverage over 10% warns mask_coverage); update:true rewrites the baseline and its sidecar; list and delete manage them. compare opens and closes one scratch target on the connected engine, always created with background:true so it never activates (on an external attach that is a real extra tab for a moment); an engine that refuses a background target is refused with a typed scratch_background_unsupported error, never retried in the foreground. Headless + CDP only: no OS input, no window.
tools.name: visual
tools.title: Visual Baselines

tools.description: Shut down the browser (owned process tree) or detach from an attached external engine (GLADIUS_CDP_URL; engine left running)
tools.name: close
tools.title: Close
